project_name: Run Evidence, PM Feedback and Agent Behavior Learning
description: Persist redacted replayable run logs and immutable structured evidence, provide PM with complete delivery facts and actionable remediation contracts, inject feedback into the next agent run, and manage evidence-backed long-term behavior memory.

tech_stack.database: PostgreSQL-compatible schema through repository migration process
tech_stack.infrastructure: DB-backed compressed artifact chunks in phase 1; storage abstraction allows object storage later

architecture_decisions.decision: Use an ArtifactStore plus immutable RunEvidence versions instead of one database row per log line.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Preserves ordered replay while avoiding database write amplification and keeping PM and agent prompts bounded.
alternatives_considered: Persist every log frame as a row
Persist only Run.summary and Git diff
Store artifacts only in external object storage

architecture_decisions.decision: Keep Run execution state independent from evidence completeness and delivery quality.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Run success continues to mean that an inspectable result was received; PM owns delivery decisions, while missing evidence is explicit and cannot be treated as approval.
alternatives_considered: Fail Run when artifact persistence fails
Let evidence completeness redefine Run state

architecture_decisions.decision: Represent long-term improvement as governed behavior memory, not model training or automatic mutation of project agent-memory files.
architecture_decisions.rationale: Behavior rules remain evidence-backed, scoped, reversible and measurable, and a single PM mistake cannot permanently poison future runs.
alternatives_considered: Automatically append every PM finding to agent-memory

tasks.title: Add evidence, artifact, acceptance and behavior-memory data contracts
tasks.description: Create database migration, entities, DAOs and DTOs for RunArtifact, RunArtifactChunk, RunEvidence, AgentBehaviorMemory and RunBehaviorMemory. Add CodingTask and PlanPatchOperation acceptanceCriteria, TaskDeliveryReview evidence/remediation fields, and CliRunResult exitCode.
acceptance_criteria: Migration and JPA mappings agree on every column, index and unique constraint
No tenant_code or tenant isolation is introduced
CodingTask creation and PlanPatch task creation preserve acceptanceCriteria
Historical tasks resolve criteria from planJson or report explicit missing evidence
Artifact content is not added directly to oc_run

tasks.title: Persist and replay redacted ordered run logs
tasks.description: Replace direct-only WebSocket emission with a CompositeRunLogSink that broadcasts and writes gzip chunks. Add sequence numbers, redaction, retention, completeness and historical frame APIs.
acceptance_criteria: Claude and Codex stdout, stderr and system frames replay in original sequence
The implementation does not write one database row per frame
Secrets and sensitive file contents are redacted before persistence
Truncation and write failures are explicit and do not alter Run state
A 100000-frame load test stays within configured memory and chunk bounds

tasks.title: Capture exit codes, Git state and immutable RunEvidence
tasks.description: Propagate process exitCode, capture Git state before releasing the workspace lease, parse final and validation outputs, evaluate actual acceptance criteria, create evidence versions and link observations to evidence IDs.
acceptance_criteria: Process exitCode and validation-command exitCodes are stored separately
Git evidence is captured before another run can mutate the workspace
Every required acceptance criterion is PASSED, FAILED or NOT_VERIFIED
Sensitive paths are excluded and reported as excluded
Evidence extraction can be rerun from immutable artifacts without overwriting prior versions

tasks.title: Give PM complete evidence and enforce actionable remediation briefs
tasks.description: Extend delivery-review input with bounded RunEvidence and log excerpts. Extend PM output with root causes, evidence-linked findings and RemediationBrief. Validate coverage and persist the normalized brief.
acceptance_criteria: PM receives raw-log excerpts, Git diff summary, process and command exitCodes, and actual acceptance criteria
APPROVE is rejected when required evidence is missing or a required criterion failed
Every PM finding references existing evidence
Every failed criterion is covered by a required change and verification step
REPLAN still resolves to one coding task that fixes and verifies

tasks.title: Inject authoritative PM feedback into the next agent run
tasks.description: Add AgentFeedbackPromptAssembler and completion-output contract. Inject remediation brief, failed criteria, verification steps and bounded evidence excerpts into RETRY and REPLAN runs, and track the applied run.
acceptance_criteria: The next agent prompt contains root causes, required changes, verification steps and failed criteria
Machine feedback does not depend on comment metadata
Complete raw logs are never copied into the prompt
Feedback-to-run linkage is idempotent and auditable
Agent final output reports resolved findings and acceptance results

tasks.title: Implement governed long-term agent behavior memory
tasks.description: Create candidate deduplication, promotion, approval, disablement, expiry, scoped retrieval, prompt injection and outcome evaluation. Do not automatically edit project agent-memory files.
acceptance_criteria: A single normal finding remains CANDIDATE
Repeated evidence from distinct runs can promote under configuration
Security and destructive-operation rules require human approval
Only applicable ACTIVE memories enter prompts and the prompt budget is enforced
Disabled memories stop appearing in new prompts
Recurring findings mark injected memories ineffective instead of strengthening them

tasks.title: Display historical logs, structured evidence, remediation and behavior memory
tasks.description: Load historical log frames before live WebSocket subscription, deduplicate by sequence, display evidence completeness, commands, findings, acceptance results, Git artifacts, PM remediation and injected behavior memory.
acceptance_criteria: A completed run can be reopened and its logs replayed
Historical and live frames have no duplicates or silent gaps
Truncated and missing evidence states are visible
Findings link to log ranges or diff paths
Large logs are paginated and sensitive content is not printed to browser console

tasks.title: Verify the evidence-to-repair-to-learning loop end to end
tasks.description: Run unit, integration, security, failure-injection, load and frontend tests across artifact persistence, evidence extraction, PM decisions, next-run feedback and behavior-memory lifecycle.
acceptance_criteria: A result-bearing run is successful while PM can still require a repair
Failed validation commands cannot be approved
Secrets are absent from database chunks, APIs and UI
Old Git evidence remains unchanged after a subsequent run
Artifact failure is visible but does not corrupt Run state
Repeated findings create governed memory and disabled memory is no longer injected
Configured artifact limits produce TRUNCATED rather than COMPLETE

security: Exclude sensitive file content from Git artifacts
Audit artifact downloads and behavior-memory state changes
Require human approval for security and destructive-operation behavior rules
performance: Write compressed chunks, not one row per frame
Default chunk size 64 KiB and flush interval 1 second
Bound PM excerpts and behavior-memory prompt budgets
scalability: Support TTL cleanup and capacity alerts
Allow a future object-storage implementation without changing business contracts

testing_strategy.unit_tests: Redaction, chunking, evidence parsing, acceptance mapping, PM validation, feedback assembly, memory promotion and retrieval.
testing_strategy.integration_tests: Runner to artifact to evidence to review to retry prompt, including transaction and workspace-lease ordering.
testing_strategy.e2e_tests: Defective delivery produces PM remediation, next run receives and resolves it, and repeated findings produce governed memory.
testing_strategy.performance_tests: 100000 frames and configured maximum artifact size; verify bounded memory, chunk count and replay latency.
